nodes.description: Public ERC20 token name, set once in the constructor.
Public ERC20 token symbol, set once in the constructor.
Immutable token decimals; must match underlying decimals when a wrapped asset is used.
Immutable address of the wrapped ERC20 asset pulled in on deposit and paid out on withdraw.
EIP712 typehash used to build the digest verified by permit().
EIP712 typehash used to build the digest verified by transferWithPermit().
Immutable EIP712 domain separator binding signatures to chain and verifying contract.
Public mapping holding wrapped token balances; mutated by mint, burn and all transfer paths.
Private total supply of wrapped tokens, changed in _mint and _burn.
CREATE2 initialisation flag controlling whether initVault may run once.
Flag disabling Swapout when the bridge operates in vault-only (mint/burn) mode.
Configurable timelock (default 2 days) applied to vault and minter changes.
Mapping of authorised minters/burners checked by the onlyAuth modifier.
Enumerable array of all minters ever added.
Current vault/MPC address used for access control and as the effective owner.
Minter awaiting the timelock before becoming authorised.
Timestamp at which applyMinter may promote pendingMinter.
Vault awaiting the timelock before becoming the active vault.
Timestamp used both as vault timelock and inside mpc() to switch to pendingVault.
Per-owner ERC2612 nonce consumed by permit and transferWithPermit.
ERC20 allowance mapping consumed and written by transferFrom, approve, approveAndCall and permit.
Initialises name/symbol/decimals/underlying, sets the vault, clears _init and computes DOMAIN_SEPARATOR using block.timestamp and chainid.
Returns pendingVault once block.timestamp >= delayVault, otherwise vault; the effective owner used by onlyVault.
View alias returning mpc().
onlyVault function toggling the _vaultOnly flag that gates Swapout.
One-shot onlyVault initialiser that sets vault/pendingVault, whitelists the vault as minter and stamps delayVault with block.timestamp.
onlyVault function scheduling a new vault with a delay measured from block.timestamp.
onlyVault function promoting pendingVault to vault once block.timestamp >= delayVault.
onlyVault function scheduling a new minter and setting delayMinter from block.timestamp.
onlyVault function that whitelists pendingMinter after the delay has elapsed.
onlyVault emergency function removing a minter immediately without timelock.
View returning the minters array.
onlyVault function replacing vault and pendingVault immediately and emitting LogChangeVault.
onlyAuth function minting arbitrary amounts to an arbitrary address via _mint.
onlyAuth function burning arbitrary amounts from an arbitrary address via _burn.
onlyAuth bridge entry minting wrapped tokens for an account against a recorded txhash.
Permissionless bridge exit that burns the caller balance, gated only by the _vaultOnly flag.
Pulls the caller full underlying balance with safeTransferFrom and mints wrapped tokens.
Pulls a caller-specified underlying amount with safeTransferFrom and mints wrapped tokens.
Pulls a caller-specified underlying amount and mints wrapped tokens to an arbitrary recipient.
onlyVault function minting wrapped tokens without pulling any underlying, mirroring a bridge deposit.
Internal helper validating underlying configuration and minting wrapped tokens 1:1.
Burns the caller entire balance and transfers the underlying back.
Burns a caller-specified amount and transfers the underlying back to the caller.
Burns a caller-specified amount and transfers the underlying to an arbitrary recipient.
onlyVault function burning from an arbitrary account and sending underlying to an arbitrary recipient.
Internal helper that burns first and then performs the external underlying transfer.
Internal supply-increasing routine writing _totalSupply and balanceOf.
Internal supply-decreasing routine writing balanceOf and _totalSupply.
Writes allowance for the caller and emits Approval.
Writes allowance then makes an external ERC677-style callback to the spender.
Sets allowance from an EIP712/PersonalSign signature using caller-supplied v, r, s, deadline and nonce.
Moves balances based only on a signature, with a full balance write before returning.
Internal ecrecover check of an EIP712 digest against DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
Internal ecrecover check of an eth_sign prefixed digest.
Moves wrapped tokens from the caller to a recipient and rewrites balanceOf.
Moves wrapped tokens using allowance, decreasing it unless set to uint256 max.
Moves wrapped tokens then calls onTokenTransfer on the recipient contract.
Caller-controlled address used for auth checks, balance writes, burns and callbacks.
Miner/validator influenceable timestamp used for permit deadlines and vault/minter timelocks.
External underlying transfer executed after the burn inside _withdraw, allowing reentrancy from ERC677-capable underlying tokens.
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn performs an unchecked-goal low-level call to an arbitrary token address.
External onTokenTransfer callback to an arbitrary recipient after balances were rewritten.
External onTokenApproval callback to an arbitrary spender after allowance was written.
Authority over allowance delegated to ecrecover over caller-supplied (v, r, s) and mutable nonce.
Token transfer authorised solely by an ecrecover signature over caller-supplied parameters.
Unchecked-by-design supply/balance increments in _mint that must never overflow.
Supply/balance decrements in _burn that rely on prior balance validation.
Swapout lets any caller burn its own balance and emit a bridge exit event without authentication.
Direct balanceOf rewrite in transferWithPermit driven only by signature verification.

signature expiry compared against block.timestamp.
ECDSA recovery id supplied by the caller.
ECDSA signature r component supplied by the caller.
ECDSA signature s component supplied by the caller.
bridge transaction hash recorded by Swapin.
constructor argument stored in the name state variable.
constructor argument stored in the symbol state variable.
constructor argument stored in the decimals state variable.
constructor argument stored in the underlying state variable.
boolean argument of setVaultOnly written to _vaultOnly.
EIP712 struct hash passed into verifyEIP712/verifyPersonalSign.
Cached underlying balance of the caller in deposit().
Cached balanceOf entry used by transfer, transferFrom, transferAndCall and transferWithPermit.
Cached allowance value read in transferFrom.
Reduced allowance written back in transferFrom.
Struct hash assembled in permit and transferWithPermit from user parameters and nonce.
Digest fed to ecrecover in verifyEIP712 and verifyPersonalSign.
Address recovered from the signature, compared against the claimed owner.
Extcodehash of the target in Address.isContract.
Constant empty-account codehash compared in Address.isContract.
Boolean result of the low-level call in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn.
Optional returndata decoded as a bool after the low-level token call.
Chain id read via assembly and committed into DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.

edges.reason: onlyVault compares the caller address against block-derived mpc().
mpc() switches ownership to pendingVault based on block.timestamp versus delayVault.
mpc returns pendingVault after the timelock.
mpc reads delayVault to decide which vault is active.
mpc falls back to vault before the timelock.
setVaultOnly is entered only through the onlyVault msg.sender check.
setVaultOnly writes the _vaultOnly flag.
initVault is guarded by onlyVault.
initVault requires _init and then clears it, making the call one-shot per deployment.
initVault assigns the active vault.
initVault assigns pendingVault.
initVault whitelists the new vault inside isMinter.
initVault overwrites delayVault.
initVault takes block.timestamp as the vault activation time.
setVault is guarded by onlyVault.
setVault stores the requested vault as pendingVault.
setVault schedules delayVault.
setVault derives the activation time from block.timestamp plus delay.
setVault consumes the configurable delay state variable.
applyVault promotes pendingVault into vault.
applyVault requires block.timestamp to have passed the scheduled time.
delayVault is the gate that applyVault checks.
setMinter is guarded by onlyVault.
setMinter stores the requested minter as pendingMinter.
setMinter schedules delayMinter.
setMinter derives delayMinter from block.timestamp.
applyMinter whitelists pendingMinter inside isMinter.
applyMinter requires block.timestamp to exceed delayMinter.
delayMinter gates applyMinter.
revokeMinter removes a minter from isMinter immediately.
revokeMinter is guarded only by the onlyVault check.
changeVault replaces the active vault instantly without timelock.
changeVault also resets pendingVault.
changeVault records block.timestamp in the LogChangeVault event.
mint onlyAuth requires isMinter[msg.sender].
The isMinter mapping is the authorisation gate for mint.
mint delegates to _mint with an attacker-chosen recipient and amount if auth is bypassed.
burn onlyAuth requires isMinter[msg.sender].
burn delegates to _burn on an arbitrary account.
Swapin mints wrapped tokens for a bridge-reported account.
Swapout burns the balance of the calling address.
Swapout is gated only by the mutable _vaultOnly flag.
Swapout reaches the internal burn routine with no authentication.
Swapout performs an unauthorised burn and emits a bridge exit event.
_burn rewrites balances and supply, which are arithmetic-critical.
_totalSupply is decremented in _burn.
balanceOf[account] is decremented in _burn.
_mint increases balances and supply, which are arithmetic-critical.
_totalSupply is incremented in _mint.
balanceOf[account] is incremented in _mint.
_deposit validates that underlying is configured and distinct from this contract.
_deposit mints one wrapped token per underlying unit received.
deposit(uint256) pulls the specified amount then calls _deposit.
deposit(uint256,address) pulls the specified amount then credits a third party.
deposit() pulls the entire underlying balance of the caller then calls _deposit.
deposit() reads the caller underlying balance.
depositVault is onlyVault and mints without any underlying inflow.
withdraw() forwards the caller full balance to _withdraw.
withdraw(uint256) forwards a caller-chosen amount to _withdraw.
withdraw(uint256,address) forwards a caller-chosen amount and recipient to _withdraw.
withdrawVault is onlyVault and can debit an arbitrary account.
_withdraw burns the wrapped tokens before any external interaction.
_withdraw performs an external underlying transfer after the burn.
A malicious underlying token can call back into withdraw before _withdraw completes.
The low-level SafeERC20 call can hand control to an arbitrary token that re-enters _withdraw.
deposit() routes the underlying pull through SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve sets the allowance of the calling address.
approveAndCall writes allowance before making the external callback.
approveAndCall invokes an external approval receiver after writing state.
The IApprovalReceiver callback may re-enter approveAndCall with a fresh allowance.
transferAndCall invokes an external token receiver after rewriting balances.
The ITransferReceiver callback may re-enter transferAndCall.
transferAndCall rewrites balanceOf entries before the callback.
transfer rewrites the caller and recipient balanceOf entries.
transfer moves the balance of the calling address.
transferFrom decreases the caller allowance unless it is uint256 max.
transferFrom rewrites the source and destination balances.
transferFrom compares the from argument with msg.sender to decide on allowance use.
permit requires block.timestamp to be no later than the supplied deadline.
permit builds its digest from PERMIT_TYPEHASH.
permit grants allowance based on signature recovery rather than msg.sender ownership.
A verified permit signature writes allowance for the target owner.
permit calls the EIP712 verification routine.
permit falls back to eth_sign style verification.
verifyEIP712 folds DOMAIN_SEPARATOR into the recovered digest.
transferWithPermit builds its digest from TRANSFER_TYPEHASH.
transferWithPermit enforces block.timestamp <= deadline.
transferWithPermit moves tokens purely on a signature check.
A verified signature lets the caller debit an arbitrary target balance.
transferWithPermit performs direct balance arithmetic outside transferFrom.
balanceOf[target] is reduced and balanceOf[to] increased without allowance bookkeeping.
transferWithPermit reuses verifyEIP712.
transferWithPermit reuses verifyPersonalSign.
Signature recovery id supplied by the caller feeds ecrecover in permit.
Signature r component supplied by the caller feeds ecrecover in permit.
Signature s component supplied by the caller feeds ecrecover in permit.
The signing owner address is a caller-supplied argument in transferWithPermit.
constructor stores the token name.
constructor stores the token symbol.
constructor stores the decimals.
constructor stores the wrapped underlying asset.
constructor computes the immutable DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
constructor sets the initial vault.
constructor sets pendingVault to the vault.
constructor initialises delayVault.
constructor stamps delayVault with the deployment block.timestamp.

normalization_plan.reason: The address argument is used only inside the setVault timelock flow.
The minter address argument is consumed by setMinter before applyMinter whitelists it.
The replacement vault argument is written directly by changeVault.
The recipient argument is the destination balance written on transfer paths.
The amount argument controls how much is burned in the withdraw path.
The source argument determines whose balance and allowance are debited.
The account argument is the balance credited by the mint routine.
The destination chain address is only emitted by Swapout.
The spender argument is the allowance key written by approve.
The value argument is both the allowance debit and the transferred amount.
The calldata payload is forwarded to the receiver callback in transferAndCall.
The target address is the allowance owner reconstructed from the signature.
The deadline is the expiry value compared against block.timestamp.
The recovery id is passed into the ecrecover helper.
The signature r component is passed into the ecrecover helper.
The signature s component is passed into the ecrecover helper.
The bridge transaction hash is only used by Swapin for its event.
The constructor argument is assigned to the name state variable.
The constructor argument is assigned to the symbol state variable.
The constructor argument is assigned to the decimals state variable.
The constructor argument is assigned to the underlying state variable.
The boolean argument is written straight into the _vaultOnly flag.
The struct hash is the payload verified by the ecrecover helper.
The cached underlying balance feeds the minting helper in deposit().
The cached balance is the pre-transfer value rewritten by the transfer paths.
The cached allowance is read to authorise the transfer.
The reduced allowance is written back into the allowance mapping.
The struct hash is assembled from permit arguments before signature recovery.
The digest is the direct input of ecrecover inside the verification helper.
The recovered signer is compared with the claimed signature owner.
The extcodehash result guards the low-level token call in SafeERC20.
The empty-account hash constant is compared before the low-level token call.
The success flag is required by the low-level token call helper.
The optional returndata is decoded after the low-level token call.
The chain id read via assembly is folded into the domain separator.
